verdict.rationale: Signifyd's documented API covers order event submission (Checkout and Sale), decision retrieval, chargebacks, guarantee cancellation and webhooks. The evidence shows no API for reading fraud posture or for creating and updating rules or lists such as velocity rules or blocklists, and no human approval gates for agent-proposed changes. Decision Center policies are mentioned only as being configured at a checkpoint, with no documented programmatic rule management, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my fraud posture and manage rules and lists programmatically — propose a velocity rule, update a blocklist — with human approval gates
